channel.title: Mali - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Mali, every source cited.

item.title: Mali marks 13 years since RFI journalists' murder
item.description: Family and colleagues mark the International Day for the End of Impunity for Crimes against Journalists.

item.title: Mali police arrest three suspected armed robbers in Bamako
item.description: Police seized two motorcycles, ammunition, and mobile phones during the operation in the Hippodrome district.

item.title: Moroccan ambassador highlights autonomy plan in Bamako
item.description: Driss Isbayène presented Morocco's autonomy proposal for the Sahara region, emphasizing its legal and institutional framework.

item.title: Mali police arrest suspects in three murders
item.description: Authorities in Bamako have apprehended individuals in connection with three killings that occurred in October.

item.title: Mali targets first medal at Dakar Youth Olympics
item.description: Five Malian athletes aged 15-17 compete in athletics, fencing, judo, swimming, and taekwondo.
